title: Evaluation of MSC‐Secretome Effects in an Ex Vivo Compartmentalized Osteochondral Interface Model
comparison_or_design: The cartilage-side supernatant MMP-activity experiment assessing inflammatory and MSC-secretome exposures, including its untreated reference.
observations_or_assays: Fluorometric MMP activity assay of cartilage supernatants
time_scope: Day 3 after the defined inflammatory/conditioned-medium treatment, following the reported acclimatization.
excluded: Other collection days, bone-side outcomes, Western blots, metabolic-activity and sGAG assays
Independent model-integrity and conditioned-medium characterization experiments, and numerical MMP results
population_or_material: Day-3 cartilage-side supernatants actually submitted to the MMP activity assay. Keep explant origins and CM/pCM reagent provenance in descriptive fields; do not create separate producer-cell or excised-cartilage Western-blot samples.
requested_items: Inflammatory cytokine combination, CM/pCM treatment and source-supported dose, cartilage compartment and supernatant collection interval
